purpose: Use actual retained baseline evidence to investigate and correct the scoped Go defect through the complete delivery process.

execution.instructions: Read the full scoped Go execution receipt; missing selected tests, incomplete execution and skipped proof are not acceptance. On an initial join rejection, use join_feedback and manifest to repair the concrete conflict. Evidence may be baseline/join evidence before the first combined check; it never establishes current-candidate acceptance. Read the accepted plan/card manifest and full current check/measurement evidence before repairing the combined candidate. Preserve completed cards and original acceptance; do not replan. Follow the request, AGENTS.md and docs/testing.md; keep acceptance fixed. Read the supplied baseline and measurement artifacts, including structured evidence; missing sidecars and truncated stdout are incomplete proof. Use all correction feedback. Configured steps own checks and measurements: do not run them. Hand off runnable source when measurement is needed without claiming resolution. Preserve identities, difficulty/uniqueness, saves, public validation, bounds and unrelated work. Missing capability, a material decision or no supported safe fix within limits returns blocked with precise evidence. Never change workflow, permissions or budgets. Return a summary of at most 240 characters; do not claim pending checks passed. For benchmark collectors, write full request/seed/phase/work JSON only to RUNNER_MEASURE_EVIDENCE (at most 64 JSON files and 8MiB total). Keep combined console output below 256KiB using compact summaries; never log full JSON with b.Log.
